toolCall.name: run_command
toolCall.argumentsJson: {"CommandLine":"powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command \"Get-Counter '\\Process(*)\\% Processor Time' | Select-Object -ExpandProperty CounterSamples | Where-Object { $_.CookedValue -gt 1 -and $_.InstanceName -ne '_total' -and $_.InstanceName -ne 'idle' } | Sort-Object CookedValue -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 | Format-Table InstanceName, CookedValue -AutoSize\"","Cwd":"C:\\AI-BS","WaitMsBeforeAsync":5000,"toolAction":"Running command","toolSummary":"Check real-time CPU % consumers"}
